verdict.rationale: Every documented development and testing workflow runs on PlanetScale's cloud: database branches, the pscale CLI, the hosted MCP server and service tokens all require an account. Nothing in the evidence shows a local, keyless or offline version of the engine. A community commenter also concluded that PlanetScale cannot be installed locally or used without an internet connection. Bring-your-own-cloud (PlanetScale Managed) is still an account-based cloud deployment, not keyless local development.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the same engine locally and keylessly — no account or cloud dependency — for offline development and CI tests
